dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is AI portrait generation through DiversityFaces, and the documented quota checks, prompt submission, status polling, and image download all fit that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The invocation guidance is broad for generic portrait requests and includes API-key onboarding, so agents should get clear user consent before sending prompts or registration details to the provider.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains SKILL.md and package.json only; package scripts just echo guidance and there are no install hooks, bundled executables, or automatic setup steps.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Requiring curl and BEAUTY_API_KEY is proportionate for an API-based image generator, but prompts and API credentials are sent to gen1.diversityfaces.org and may be privacy-sensitive.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill suggests optional user-managed API-key storage in environment variables or config files, but it does not implement background persistence, privilege escalation, credential harvesting, or local profile/session access.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SDI-2] expected: API-key registration is related to using the service and is disclosed, but the curl example would transmit username, email, and country to the provider, so users should do this only intentionally.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The trigger language is broader than ideal for a third-party API skill, but the behavior is not hidden and use still depends on the user having or obtaining an API key.
[SQP-2] unexpected: The skill does disclose that prompts are sent externally and says not to include sensitive or identifying information, but those warnings could be more prominent near each transmission step.
[E1] expected: Sending prompts and the API key to the provider is the core function of this API client; no artifact evidence shows unrelated or covert exfiltration.
llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that generated-image prompts and your API key will be sent to gen1.diversityfaces.org, and API-key signup may require personal details. Avoid sensitive, proprietary, or identifying content in prompts, review the provider's terms/privacy yourself, and store the API key only where you are comfortable protecting it.
llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed third-party portrait image API client, with privacy and credential cautions but no hidden install, persistence, or unrelated data access in the artifacts.
